teacher_info.introduction: ABOUT ME – Hi everyone, my name is Megan and I am an English teacher. I am a native English speaker from the US. In 2012, I earned my TEFL certificate in Santiago, Chile where I taught English from 2012-2016. I'm a patient and easy-going teacher. I love using italki because it allows me the opportunity to meet people from all over the world. This year, I decided to work as I travel. Recently, I just returned from a three month trip in Southeast Asia. MY TEACHING APPROACH – I am a very enthusiastic person and I love helping people improve their English. My goal is to make lessons interactive for you. Lessons and level themed exercises are created for each student. Of course, if there is something specific you would like to practice, please feel free to ask in advance. GENERAL CLASSES – For each general lesson, I create an interesting theme which includes related vocabulary, discussion questions, an optional reading/videos, and a fun homework assignment. In my classes, I like to have fun using music, videos, current events, and interesting discussion questions. I help correct mistakes on the spot so you will always have lots of personal feedback! You'll always learn something new in my class! BUSINESS CLASSES - Interested in improving your spoken English? In this course, we will learn formal and professional expressions and vocabulary. We will use the book Market Leader as a reference for its interesting content. If you're looking to climb the ladder, this course will help you to enhance your working language skill set. TOEFL CLASSES – Depending on your level of English and your knowledge of this exam, the class structure is subject to change. We review basic grammar, advanced vocabulary, phrasal verbs, and the format of the exam. Once you have a good grasp, we begin to learn about each section: Listening / Reading / Writing / Speaking. Remember that the TOEFL takes a lot of patience and time but together, we can do it!

pro_course_detail.title: English (Beginner to Intermediate) 25/40 minutes
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner lessons are designed for children who are just beginning their English language journey. Lessons are 25 minutes and feature an interactive lesson that focuses on the 26 letters of the alphabet, phonics, sight words, numbers and more!
Elementary to intermediate courses contain interactive lessons based on the CEFR/Cambridge model with a wide range of topics including animals, jobs, travel, food, school, clothing, body and many more! We will also practice important parts of the English language such as phonics, adjectives, numbers, pronouns, demonstratives, capitalization, regular plurals, present continuous, possessive pronouns, prepositions, and simple past/future throughout the units. All lessons are designed for kids.

Want to speak English more clearly and naturally? As a linguist and pronunciation specialist, I help students correct pronunciation mistakes and gain confidence in their speech. My lessons are structured, supportive, and designed for real progress.  

What to Expect:  

- Focused Sound Training: You’ll read carefully chosen sentences. This allows me to identify pronunciation issues and help you correct all 50 American English sounds.  
 
- Custom Practice Materials: You’ll get word lists, spelling patterns, and tips to help you improve.  
 
- Practical Speaking Exercises: We’ll practice reading short articles aloud. This helps with pronunciation, fluency, and vocabulary growth.  
 
- Advanced Techniques: Learn how to stress words correctly, pronounce the schwa, relax your T, find your R, and handle -ed endings and final S sounds.  
 
- Step-by-Step Approach: Many students say they want a clear and systematic method—this course provides exactly that.  
 
- Optional Music-Based Practice: I’ve also created original songs with lyrics to help reinforce key sounds in a fun and natural way.  

I love teaching pronunciation and truly care about your progress. My lessons are structured but relaxed, detailed but enjoyable. You’ll feel supported every step of the way.  

Most students need about 10 class hours to practice and correct all 50 sounds. The best option is a 15-lesson package (45 minutes each). This allows time for refinement and conversation practice. Plus, ordering 15 lessons comes with a 10% discount.  

If you're ready to speak with more confidence, let’s get started!

course_info.trial_description: Hello my name is Sean, and I use this lesson to get to know the student and explain what classes I offer. This first lesson is simply about getting to know each other, and assessing what goals are important to you in English. We will not have a sample class. This is simply a meeting of the minds. I want to discover what motivates you, and what your needs are in improving your English. Contact me today so we can take your first step towards fluency!

pro_course_detail.title: General English Course: Speak English Effortlessly by Studying Current Events
pro_course_detail.description: This is a dynamic course that features articles and videos related to current events. Each week the student will receive an article or video that highlights a controversial issue. After reviewing the material, the student will come to class prepared to discuss  the issue with the teacher. In the course of this discussion vocabulary words, cultural insights, and correct phrasing will be emphasized. However, the true goal of the course is help the student become confident in expressing opinions and make speak English feel like second nature.

pro_course_detail.title: 30 Minute Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description: Learn to Speak like an American with a USA Native from California! Let's chat! Set aside half an hour of your day to speak with a native. Learn the rhythm of an American accent while enjoying great conversation! This class will also give you a taste of what my Business & General English classes are like. No materials or homework assignments are included.

pro_course_detail.title: Mock Interviews & Presentations : Close the Deal
pro_course_detail.description: Learn How to Master Presentations and Interviews in an American Business Environment! In this class we will concentrate on improving your public speaking by conducting mock interviews and/or presentations. Through this process I will provide you with insight on how to make yourself more marketable to US employers and ensure that you are ready to take the next step in your professional life! This class helps you close the deal!!!

pro_course_detail.title: American Business Writing & Editing
pro_course_detail.description: This course is to help students crack the code for the proper decorum when writing for American Business and Academic environments. You will learn how to communicate effectively and concisely when emailing co-workers, clients, vendors, administrators and your superiors. We will discuss the art of business  and academic writing, while breaking down the right tone for each situation. I'll train you to avoid unnecessary phrases and greetings that sound awkward to a native, while also focusing on what information is the most relevant. Some materials are provided, but the best results occur while editing and rewriting your existing business emails, resumes, cover-letters and Academic essays.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English Course
pro_course_detail.description: Acclimate Yourself to the American Legal Environment! This Legal English course will assist international lawyers and law students in making the transition into practicing law in the United states.  This course is here to provide you with the insight you need to communicate effectively in the legal profession in English. I will expose you to various fields of law within the context of real cases and current events. Overall the goal is to help ESL lawyers speak persuasively in a professional environment.  Please be advised that this is an English class and will in no way constitute legal advice. Fields of law to be covered include Personal Injury/Litigation, Intellectual Property, Business, Civil/Human Rights, Labor, Criminal and Civil Procedure.
